## Starting point
Make long result lists easier to navigate without reducing the accessibility of the checker UI.

## Work to do
Add severity filters, text search, and a status summary; support keyboard navigation and clear focus styles.

## Acceptance criteria
Counts remain stable when filtered; no-results state is clear; screenshot and keyboard-check notes in PR.

## Before submitting
Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and explain what you changed, what you tested, and any limitations. Ask a maintainer to assign this issue before starting.
